description: Deeper than it is wide, and every inch of it accounted for. Spinner racks down the middle, sleeved back-issues wall to wall in graded rows, and a glass counter at the far end lit from underneath so the cards inside float on a shelf of white light. The air is cold and dry — dehumidifier running somewhere behind the wall, because paper is the whole business — and it smells of newsprint, warm electronics and, faintly, of soup. Handwritten cards are taped to everything. ASK BEFORE HANDLING. GRADING IS NOT A CONVERSATION. NO, IT IS NOT WORTH THAT.
name: Mint Condition — Shop Floor
